ch.introducao.title: Introduction
ch.introducao.subtitle: An Invitation to See Again
ch.introducao.b.0.text: This book was written for adults who live alongside, care for, teach, or accompany autistic children. People who are inside the process — fathers, mothers, caregivers, teachers, therapists — and not merely observing from outside.
ch.introducao.b.1.text: It does not set out to explain autism as a diagnosis, nor to organize behaviors into lists of symptoms. It was not conceived as a manual for application, a closed protocol, or a method to be followed step by step. It is born from another place.
ch.introducao.b.2.text: What holds this book is a more fundamental question: what is happening when the child acts as she acts?
ch.introducao.b.3.text: Throughout these pages, behavior is understood as a response. Every repetition, every insistence, every withdrawal, every pause carries a function. The gesture does not arise as error — but as an attempt to keep something alive: the body, the action, the axis, the relationship.
ch.introducao.b.4.text: From the beginning, this book rests on the understanding that development happens in a non-linear way. It takes shape in the body, in time, in contact with objects, and progressively, in relationship with the other.
ch.introducao.b.5.text: Every child moves through that path in a singular way — with advances, retreats, and pauses that belong to the real process. That is why the chapters do not organize themselves as a mandatory sequence, but as fields that open, cross, and deepen.
ch.introducao.b.6.text: A child may be far ahead in one aspect and still need basic holding in another. This uneven movement belongs to a living development.
ch.introducao.b.7.text: To the adult, this book proposes another place. Not that of the absolute specialist, nor of the mere executor of instructions — but of someone who learns to read the process: someone who observes, holds, and articulates the relationship between the child, the environment, and the professionals.
ch.introducao.b.8.text: Nothing written here asks for immediate agreement. What is invited is another kind of reading: without hurry and free from the anxious search for isolated answers. Throughout the book, no ready solutions accumulate — but a form of understanding that builds and matures with time.
ch.introducao.b.9.text: That understanding begins from a simple recognition: explaining too much does not help, correcting too soon gets in the way, and accelerating development can interrupt something that was still forming.
ch.introducao.b.10.text: If at any moment it seems that no quick solutions are offered — that is not absence. It is choice.
ch.introducao.b.11.text: Development is not resolved. Development is accompanied.
ch.introducao.b.12.text: If, at the end of the reading, there is no list of techniques — but there is a more attuned gaze, a more precise listening, and a steadier presence alongside the child — then this book has fulfilled its purpose.
ch.introducao.b.13.text: This book builds itself from the observation of child development in its living dimension — the one that happens in the body, in relationship, and in daily life. It is in dialogue with the field of autism and development, but chooses not to rest on terminologies or technical classifications as its axis of reading.
ch.introducao.b.14.text: The understanding here is born from accompanied experience, from attentive listening, and from the reading of processes in movement. What is proposed is not to explain from the outside — but to hold a gaze that learns to recognize, from within, how development organizes itself when it encounters presence, time, and relationship.
